messages:
Alex: Kicking off the canary for rate-policy-v2 (burst caps tightened). Canary = 2% traffic in eu-west. Noticed a small bump in 429s right after push, tagging SRE and Support to confirm.

Priya: Support seeing multiple tickets from Acme and BetaCorp complaining about sudden 429s + retries causing unexpected billing increases. Customers report Retry-After not present in responses so clients retry aggressively.

Jordan: Looking at edge logs now — 429 spike aligns exactly with canary rollout window 09:12-09:18 UTC. Quick sample: `request_id=abc123 status=429 route=/v1/generate client_id=acme rate_limit_remaining=0` — downstream shows burst tokens exhausted.

Mei: Rolling config snippet we pushed (excerpt):
```
rate_policy:
  name: rate-policy-v2
  default:
    per_minute: 300
    burst: 20   # tightened from 100 previously
  per_customer_overrides: {}
canary:
  pct: 2
  regions: [eu-west]
```

Mei: The change intentionally reduced burst to lower tail cost, but looks like some high-burst customers are hitting it and their SDKs retry quickly. Also noticed our gateway omitted `Retry-After` header for 429s from the new limiter path (bug?).

Alex: Ok — proposed immediate steps: 1) Pause canary traffic split for rate-policy-v2, 2) revert burst value back to 100 for eu-west canary, 3) re-deploy gateway fix to ensure `Retry-After` present. Can someone take steps 1 & 2? I can coordinate the deploy.

Carlos: I can flip the traffic split in traffic-router: setting canary pct to 0 for experiment id `rp-v2-eu-2026`. Will do now and report.

deploy-bot: traffic-router update: experiment rp-v2-eu-2026 pct set 0 -> deploy success (09:26:41 UTC).

Jordan: After traffic split -> 429 rate dropped back toward baseline in eu-west. Support reports fewer new tickets. Still need the Retry-After header fix before re-attempting any rollout.

Priya: Notifying affected customers with a short blurb: we rolled back the canary in eu-west due to unexpected 429s, investigating SDK interactions and will follow up. Please include a contact for escalations.

Mei: For root cause: two issues converged — over-aggressive burst tightening for certain multi-threaded clients + our limiter code path not setting `Retry-After`. Action items I have: open bug for header (ENG-RATE-412), add per-customer overrides for known high-burst tenants before next canary, and add metric for "retry loop amplification".

Alex: Good. Owners: Carlos (traffic flip), Mei (header bug + policy tweaks), Jordan (verify infra metrics + smoke tests), Priya (customer comms). Let's meet T+2h for short postmortem if no further regressions. :thumbsup:

Carlos: traffic flip done and monitoring green. :eyes:

Jordan: creating a short smoke test script to simulate multi-threaded SDK bursts and ensure limiter returns `Retry-After` with proper values. Will link PR.

Priya: Customers notified. Messaging: "We temporarily paused the canary for rate-policy-v2 in eu-west — no action required on your side. If you continue to see 429s, please share recent request_ids."

Alex: Thanks everyone. We'll re-open a controlled canary only after the header fix + per-customer overrides. Leaving thread open for updates.
